title: AnalyzeResponse
description: Response returned by an analyzer after processing a request.

DegradedResolution.title: DegradedResolution
DegradedResolution.description: A group of files whose type resolution was degraded and the reason.

files.description: Absolute paths of files whose type resolution was degraded.

reason.description: Why the type resolution was degraded, in terms a human can act on.

protocol.description: Protocol version. Always 1 for this schema.

violations.description: Rule violations found in the analyzed files.

skipped.description: Files the analyzer could not process.

diagnostics.description: Runtime diagnostics emitted by the analyzer.

degraded.description: Files whose type resolution was degraded. The core withholds semantic findings for these files. Optional for backward compatibility.
